metadata.description: ProofGate — the acceptance gate that doesn't accept 'I think it works.'

plugins.name: proofgate
plugins.description: A delivery gate that charges in proportion to what the change can break, and where evidence is EARNED rather than typed: claims are recorded by running the command that proves them, refutations outlive a context compaction, memory anchored to code announces its own staleness, the status is generated from the ledger, and the proof is sealed to the commit as a git note CI verifies. 23 diff guards, a SHA-bound verdict, hooks that refuse an unproven push. Born from real production scars in AI-assisted development.
